delta.comment: Stage fix cycle 2 (2026-08-19, current-HEAD review of 5882fb4d, P1). The authoritative C3 clause required a review-thread reply UNCONDITIONALLY, while the carriers 134.004-T and 134.007-T had already been corrected to support threadless findings -- leaving the authoritative definition as the stale outlier. An unconditional C3 is unsatisfiable on two surfaces P-021 governs: Ship's local review runs BEFORE PR creation, and build/CI findings have no review thread even on an open PR, so it forced Ship either to violate the clause or fabricate a thread. Corrected: C3's reference obligation is now CONDITIONAL ON ACTUAL THREAD AVAILABILITY -- where a thread exists, cite the deferred entry ID in the reply (posted before resolution) and in the PR/closure residual-risk record; where none exists, the obligation is discharged IN FULL by the task/run/closure residual-risk citation and the absent reply is explicitly not a C3 shortfall. The Relationship-to-P-018 criterion was made precise at the same time: P-018 governs threads only, so a threadless discharge leaves no unresolved thread and raises no P-018 obligation. Preserved: C1, C2, C4-C7, capture-first ordering, single-write capture invariant, per-field ID availability, Stage-only reprioritization. Coherence updates applied to the plan clause table + 004 summary, 134-F restatement, and 019-DL clause 3 (amended in place with an appended C3 AMENDMENT annotation).

Contract replanning (operator-directed holistic carrier review, 2026-08-19): authoritative C2 source-ref payload corrected. Previously qualified only the review-thread ID with "when applicable" while stating the PR number unconditionally, assuming a PR always exists at capture -- false for pre-PR local-review findings, since Ship's local review runs before PR creation. Left the authoritative clause weaker than its own carriers (134.004-T was already per-field after fix cycle 1). Root form was the fused `PR/thread ID` token in 019-DL clause 2, carried into the plan clause table as `PR + review-thread ID`. All three surfaces corrected together to independent per-field availability with the fused form prohibited. Also updated the H13 staged-change inventory reference.

Readiness fix cycle 1 (P1.2, review of 1dad725a): authoritative C5 corrected. Previously prohibited Ship removal without qualification, contradicting 134.002-T (which retains only DISCRETIONARY removal as Forbidden) and hardening H2 (provenance not verb). Read literally it would have forbidden Ship's existing, correct post-merge Step 7 backlogit_stash_remove on custom_fields.source_stash_id, making every shipment closure a C5 violation. C5 now prohibits discretionary removal specifically and names manifest-derived post-merge retirement as Allowed. Third instance of the same inverse-drift shape (carriers correct, authority stale) after the C3 and C2 amendments. Also added the explicit C5 criterion here, which previously read only "C5 Ship capture-only carve-out present."
